name: Case Western Reserve University
academic_ranking: Private research university in Cleveland, OH; highly selective and consistently ranked among the top ~50 national universities. Strong reputation in engineering, sciences, pre-med/nursing, and business.
financial_aid: As an NCAA Division III institution, CWRU does not offer athletic scholarships. Financial aid is need- and merit-based; eligibility is calculated by subtracting expected family contribution from cost of attendance. CWRU follows the College Cost Transparency Initiative Principles & Standards. Office of University Financial Aid: 216.368.4530, financialaid@case.edu. Total 2026-27 first-year cost of attendance approx. $95,704 (residential) / $80,364 (commuter).
facilities_notes: Spartans play home softball games on campus at the Case Western Reserve softball field within the university's athletics complex. Detailed facility specs not published on the softball program page; staff directory/site checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the highly competitive University Athletic Association (UAA), a conference of academically elite private research institutions. Combines rigorous academics with competitive D3 softball.
notes: Coaching staff and roster captured from athletics.case.edu softball pages (2026 season) on 2026-07. Roster size of 23 taken from the 2026 softball roster page. No athletic scholarships offered (D3). Team social account: CWRU_Softball.
